# LiFePO4 is the better choice for most buyers

**LiFePO4 (LFP) is the better pick for nearly everyone.** NMC's one real advantage is weight, and in finished power stations that gap is smaller than you might expect.

## How they compare

| | LiFePO4 (LFP) | NMC |
|---|---|---|
| **Rated cycle life** | Usually 3,000–6,000 cycles. The median rating is about 4,000. | Usually 500–1,000 cycles. The median rating is about 800. |
| **Behavior when a cell fails** | Burns cooler and slower | Hotter and more violent |
| **Weight** | A bit heavier | About 10–16% lighter per Wh in finished units |
| **Price** | Now usually cheaper per Wh | Mostly older or compact models |
| **Cold charging** | Most won't charge below 32°F | Most won't charge below 32°F |

Sources: [OutageMath](https://www.outagemath.com/guides/lifepo4-vs-nmc/), [powerstations.reviews](https://powerstations.reviews/guides/lifepo4-vs-nmc), [UnpluggedWatts](https://www.unpluggedwatts.com/lifepo4-vs-nmc-power-station/)

## What this means for you

- **Daily use (van, RV, off-grid solar):** Choose LiFePO4. At one full cycle a day, a 500-cycle NMC unit reaches 80% capacity in about 1.4 years. A 3,000-cycle LFP unit takes about 8 years. ([UnpluggedWatts](https://www.unpluggedwatts.com/lifepo4-vs-nmc-power-station/))
- **Kept indoors or in a vehicle:** Choose LiFePO4. In lab tests, LFP cells peaked at about 259°C, while NMC cells peaked at about 731°C. In one large-cell overcharge test, the LFP cell only smoked, but every NMC cell caught fire. ([OutageMath](https://www.outagemath.com/guides/lifepo4-vs-nmc/), [UnpluggedWatts](https://www.unpluggedwatts.com/lifepo4-vs-nmc-power-station/))
- **Occasional outage backup or a few camping trips a year:** Either chemistry works. Cycle count won't be the limit for you; age and how you store the unit will. ([powerstations.reviews](https://powerstations.reviews/guides/lifepo4-vs-nmc))
- **Weight matters most:** Compare actual models rather than chemistries. One LFP unit, the Anker SOLIX C1000, holds *more* Wh per pound than the NMC Goal Zero Yeti 1000. ([UnpluggedWatts](https://www.unpluggedwatts.com/lifepo4-vs-nmc-power-station/))

## Caveats

- **LFP isn't fireproof.** The same 2020 study found LFP cells went into thermal runaway *earlier* under overcharge, even though the failure was milder. Some sites, such as VoltVanguard, say LFP "can withstand overcharging," which overstates it.
- **Check what a cycle rating counts down to.** "4,000 cycles to 70%" promises less than "4,000 cycles to 80%."
- **Already own a working NMC unit?** There's no need to replace it.
- **Buy for fit first.** Make sure the capacity and inverter can run what you need, then pick the chemistry.

## Example LiFePO4 station
